notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from itself, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath and choose to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
